text:
Nina Park: FYI I'm seeing a rise in unassigned leads during UK morning. could be hubspot webhook lag or enrichment backlog.
Owen McCoy: saw the same. can we add a tiny probe to track recv->enrich->assign times? want to prove where the delay is.
Rhea Das: yes. minimal fields: hashed_lead, connector(hs|sf), recv_ts, enrich_done_ts, assign_ts, owner_type(rr|default|manual), fallback_flag. sample 10% first.
Leo Grant: add tenant_region and batch_id for correlation. and include `slo_breach` if assign_ts - recv_ts > 120s.
Nina Park: also track `first_outbound_ts` when SDR touches it. that shows real handoff.
Owen McCoy: opt-out via metadata.probe=false. hashed_lead must be salted per-tenant. legal confirmed no raw PII.
Rhea Das: where to pump events? propose kafka topic inbound.handoff.probes -> small consumer -> metrics exporter.
Leo Grant: I'll build the consumer, emit Prom gauges and p95 histograms. dashboard card in Console -> inbound-routing.
Nina Park: add alerts: p95 assign latency > 180s -> page oncall. and fallback_rate > 1% sustained -> ops alert.
Owen McCoy: rollout plan: internal tenant full-sample 24h -> 10% prod 48h -> 50% 3d -> aggregate-only. canary rule: if avg latency > 3m on canary, auto-disable sampling.
Rhea Das: ticket MKT-4710: "Handoff probe + connector split dashboard" created and assigned to @Leo and @Owen.
SyncBot: webhook received portal=901 at 1748509999 (event hb_12001)
Leo Grant: PR for consumer by Thu EOD; staging run Fri; prod canary Mon. I'll include unit tests for hashing and schema.
Nina Park: include per-connector heatmap (HubSpot vs Salesforce) and business-owner fallback counts for CS.
Owen McCoy: agree. and add metric `rr_fairness_skew` sampled to detect owner imbalance.
Rhea Das: good. add `connector_batch_size` so we can correlate bulk imports -> backlog.
SyncBot: SF bulk import 789 finished 1748510100 size=8200
Leo Grant: noted. will surface batch impact on dashboard.
Nina Park: ok folks, follow-ups: Leo push consumer PR, Owen configure topic+alerts, Rhea finalize sampling rules, I'll draft customer note for sales. reconvene after staging run. :sparkles:
